tasks.gr11-business-environments-influences-t1: Topic: Business Environments and Influences. Cover the micro, market and macro environments, PESTLE factors, internal control factors, and how each environment influences South African businesses. Ask learners to identify environments from scenarios, classify factors, or explain links between environmental pressures and business decisions.
tasks.gr11-challenges-adapting-change-t1: Topic: Challenges and Adapting to Change. Cover socio-economic challenges (unemployment, poverty, inequality), adapting strategies, business responses to environmental pressures, and proactive vs reactive approaches. Ask learners to analyse challenge scenarios, recommend adaptations, or evaluate a business's response to a specific challenge.
tasks.gr11-business-sectors-ownership-t1: Topic: Business Sectors and Ownership Forms. Cover primary, secondary and tertiary sectors, benefits of companies versus other ownership forms, public vs private companies, and co-operatives. Ask learners to compare ownership forms, classify businesses by sector, or recommend a suitable form of ownership for a given scenario.
tasks.gr11-acquiring-a-business-t1: Topic: Acquiring a Business. Cover the four avenues: starting from scratch, buying an existing business, buying a franchise, and inheriting/entering a family business. Ask learners to compare acquisition methods, identify advantages and disadvantages, or recommend the best avenue for an entrepreneur in a given scenario.
tasks.gr11-intellectual-property-rights-t1: Topic: Intellectual property rights (Grade 11 Business Studies, Term 1). Cover what intellectual property is, copyright (original creative works, exists when the work is made), patents (new inventions, sole right for a limited period), trade marks (names, logos and slogans), piracy and its effects on a business, and business solutions such as registering rights, licences, reporting piracy and informing customers. Ask learners to match a scenario to the right, name an effect of piracy, or suggest a solution.
tasks.gr11-trade-unions-labour-relations-act-t: Topic: Trade unions and the Labour Relations Act (Grade 11 Business Studies, Term 1). Cover the nature and purpose of the Labour Relations Act, what a trade union is, a brief history of unions in South Africa, the roles and functions of unions (bargaining, representation, informing members), workplace forums, strikes, go-slows and lockouts, and the CCMA. Do not quote section numbers or wage thresholds. Ask learners to name the action in a scenario or the function of a union.
